findings.impact: Clients passing the structured cursor dictionary returned by agy_run_observe (from runs[run_id]['cursor']) to agy_run_wait's 'after' parameter will trigger a Pydantic ValidationError because agy_run_wait strictly expects a dict[str, str]. This breaks cursor compatibility between observation and wait tools.

validate_artifact does not check if the elements inside the 'findings' array are dictionaries or match the expected finding schema. A review artifact with malformed finding elements (e.g. strings instead of objects) will pass validation with valid=True and verdict=completed without any errors.

If an integer event cursor is supplied in the 'after' parameter of agy_run_observe, _observe_cursor silently discards it and treats it as None (starting events from the beginning) instead of stringifying or raising a validation error.

Configuring AGY_BRIDGE_MAX_PARALLEL to a value greater than DEFAULT_MAX_PARALLEL (50) silently caps it to 50 instead of raising a ValueError, despite the ValueError message stating that the value must be between 1 and DEFAULT_MAX_PARALLEL.
